_comment: Every user-facing string of the desk. Runtime tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation. Keys that start with an underscore are sentinels, skipped by the codegen and the unused-key audit.

now.title: Now
now.description: What is moving, what needs you, and what changed.
now.lensDownHint: What depends on it shows as unknown; everything else is current.
now.nothingNeedsYou: No supervisor is waiting on you.
now.overlapsNote: Each pair holds the same topics now. Check that only one was meant to. Earlier overlaps are on each commission's page.
now.preparedNote: Built but never started. Each launches as it is.
now.nothingOpen: No supervisor window is open. Launch research, or launch a prepared packet below.
now.liveNote: Working now: its units are running.
now.limitedNote: Window open, but the goal is usage-limited, budget-limited or blocked: nothing runs.
now.pausedNote: Window open, goal paused: nothing runs until it is resumed. Open one to resume it or wind it down.
now.sinceLookNote: Since your last look at each topic, or the last 24 hours where none is recorded. Topics with research written in the last week are listed; the supervisors above use the same period.
now.sinceNote: Topics with research written in this period, and what changed in each. The supervisors above use the same period.
now.caughtUpDescription: Records that you looked at every commission and topic now, in the desk's own state folder. Nothing in the research home changes. Changes are then counted from now.
now.caughtUpDone: Marked {{commissions}} commissions and {{topics}} topics as seen
now.nothingWritten: No research was written in this period.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.description: Every supervised run the desk can find, by state. Older layouts show what can be read.
commissions.empty: Nothing under cohorts/ in the research home. Launch research to start one.

commission.missing: This commission is not in the research home.
commission.recordError: A record in this folder cannot be read
commission.preparedTitle: This packet has not been launched.
commission.sessionsNote: An exact match comes from the launch record or the goal text; a related one only mentions this commission.
commission.touchedNote: (an edit after the end, not counted as activity)

changes.title: Since you last looked
changes.fromDatedHeadings: The sections under headings dated after this time.
changes.truncatedText: Shortened; open the file for the rest.
changes.truncatedWalk: The folder walk stopped at its limit; more files may have changed.
changes.countDay: {{count}} changes in the last 24 hours (no look recorded)
changes.countDay_one: 1 change in the last 24 hours (no look recorded)
changes.noneDay: Nothing new in the last 24 hours (no look recorded)

say.title: Say
say.note: Your words go into OPERATOR.md beside the charter. Nothing is typed into its chat.
say.windDownLabel: How it should wind down, in your words
say.confirmWindDownTitle: Ask the supervisor to wind down?
say.confirmDescription: This entry is appended to the commission's operator file; nothing is typed into the session. Below: the exact entry and when the supervisor reads it.
say.steeringUnknown: Cannot tell whether this charter reads OPERATOR.md
say.steeringOffTitle: This charter does not read OPERATOR.md yet
say.steeringOff: Entries are written but the supervisor will not see them until steering is enabled.
say.enableSteeringDescription: Adds one Steering section to the charter README.md so the supervisor reads OPERATOR.md at each unit. Nothing else in the charter changes.
say.steeringPresent: The charter already has the steering line; nothing would be written.
say.ended: This commission has ended; its supervisor reads nothing more.

control.title: Controls
control.note: These type into the supervisor's window. Each one tells you exactly what before it runs.
control.noSession: No open window for this commission matches exactly, so only discard is available here. Winding down through Say above always works.
control.pause: Types /goal pause and Enter into Web Console session {{session}}. The supervisor stops starting units until resumed.
control.resume: Types /goal resume and Enter into Web Console session {{session}}.
control.stop: Pauses the goal in Web Console session {{session}}, exits Codex and stops its background server. The session and its files are kept.
control.resend: Pastes {{path}} into Web Console session {{session}} and presses Enter.
control.discard: Marks the commission discarded in LAUNCH.json with your reason. Its files stay.
control.discardOpen: Stops the open supervisor window first, then marks the commission discarded in LAUNCH.json with your reason. Its files stay.
control.discardReason: Why discard it? (required, kept in LAUNCH.json)
control.recorded: Recorded in LAUNCH.json. Pause and resume are not among the messages the session keeps when it compacts.
control.keptSlot: Recorded in LAUNCH.json. The stance becomes one of the messages the session keeps when it compacts.
control.byHand: To do it by hand, type this in session {{session}}
control.windDownAlways: Winding down through the operator file needs nothing from the supervisor's window: it is read with the next entry the supervisor reads.

courier.title: Delivery to your phone
courier.switchLabel: Send this commission's decisions to Notification Hub
courier.onHint: Its needs-you items are sent as asks or notices.
courier.offHint: Its items are only shown here.
courier.turnOn: Needs-you items of {{id}} that appear from now on will be sent to Notification Hub on the courier's next pass, within a minute. Items open now are not sent; they stay here.
courier.turnOff: Nothing more from {{id}} will be sent. Asks already open stay open until their deadline.
courier.globalNote: Items in ATTENTION.md that belong to no commission. Off until you turn them on.
courier.globalLabel: Send global items to Notification Hub
courier.globalOn: Global ATTENTION.md items that appear from now on will be sent to Notification Hub as notices. Items open now are not sent; they stay here.
courier.globalOff: Global items will no longer be sent. Notices already delivered stay delivered.
courier.perCommission: Per-commission switches are on each commission's Steer tab. Stored in

delivery.unauthorizedTitle: This desk cannot act for you
delivery.unauthorized: Your session is not authorized, so nothing can be answered or sent from here. Sign in again, or answer in OPERATOR.md by hand.
delivery.notWriter: This instance does not hold the write lock, so it sends nothing. Answers written here still reach the supervisor.
delivery.allOff: Delivery is off: {{count}} open items reach you only here.
delivery.allOff_one: Delivery is off: 1 open item reaches you only here.

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.description: Everything a supervisor is waiting on. Your answer goes to the commission's OPERATOR.md; the confirmation says when its supervisor reads it.
needsYou.empty: No supervisor is waiting on a decision.
needsYou.read: A unit has run since you answered.
needsYou.notRead: Not read by the supervisor yet.
needsYou.secret: Put it here, not in the desk: {{where}}
needsYou.confirmDescription: Appended to the commission's OPERATOR.md. Nothing is typed into its chat. Below: the exact entry and when it is read.
needsYou.orphansNote: The item left its file, but the desk cannot withdraw an ask; it stays open until its deadline and an answer to it is ignored.
needsYou.askStaysOpen: This item is also an open ask on your phone. The desk cannot withdraw it: it stays open there until it expires, and an answer given there later is ignored.
needsYou.reused: {{id}} already had an answer or a delivery before this item appeared, so it was not sent, and an answer here would read as the earlier one's. Ask the supervisor to write it again under a new ID.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Every research topic, newest research write first.
topics.empty: No topics/<name>/MISSION.md in the research home.
topics.work: {{open}} open, {{active}} active, {{waiting}} waiting on you, {{landed}} landed
topics.noCommissions: No commission has held this topic.

reading.none: No read set can be measured for this commission.
reading.ceilingsUnknown: none found; sizes are shown without flags

files.title: File
files.outside: This file is outside the research home, so the desk does not serve it.
files.htmlOpens: Opens in a new tab with its media. Scripts stay off.

gates.stance_ending: Stance ends with the ready line

preflight.noEarlier: No earlier commission on these topics.
preflight.blockersNote: Each still holds one of these topics. The desk's recommendation is selected; change it here.
preflight.statePaused: Paused with its window open, on {{topics}}.
preflight.stateUnknown: The desk cannot tell whether it still runs, on {{topics}}.
preflight.holdNote: The launch waits until you choose.
preflight.readFirstOn: Have the {{topic}} owner read its newest checkpoint first
preflight.packetStateNote: The start of the packet's own STATE.md, as written, so advice there is seen before launching. It never blocks.
preflight.packetStateTruncated: The first lines only; the rest is in the file.
preflight.ownerReading: What each owner reads to start
preflight.ownerReadingNote: Measured, never blocking. A flag says what to do about it.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Choose topics and say what matters. The desk builds the packet, checks it, and starts the supervisor.
launch.preparedNote: Each launches as it is, without building a new packet.
launch.manualMode: Automatic launch is not available ({{reason}}). The desk builds the packet and gives you the two messages to paste into a new Codex session.
launch.stepTopicsNote: Up to {{max}}. Each becomes one owner card.
launch.stepCardsNote: Leave the order empty to follow the mission, or pick up to {{max}} workstreams in the order to work them.
launch.cardsAfterTopics: Each topic you choose gets a card here.
launch.noLive: No open, active or approved workstream.
launch.stepWordsNote: Quoted verbatim in the stance message, which the supervisor keeps through every compaction.
launch.allowanceHint: From {{min}} to {{max}}. The supervisor winds down when it runs out.
launch.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; the date is added.
launch.costModel: {{model}} uses more of your quota per hour than the default {{base}}.
launch.costEffort: {{effort}} effort uses more of your quota per hour than {{base}}.
launch.costOwner: Owners on {{model}} use more of your quota than the default.
launch.stepCheckNote: Rebuilt in memory as you change anything above. Nothing is written until you launch.
launch.needQuotes: Write at least one stance quote.
launch.needAllowance: Set an allowance from {{min}} to {{max}} hours.
launch.messagesNote: Sent in this order and nothing else: the stance, then the goal once the supervisor replies ready.
launch.kernelHint: Send after the supervisor replies ready.
launch.confirmStep1: Writes the packet folder cohorts/{{id}} in the research home.
launch.confirmStep2: Opens a new Codex session in Web Console.
launch.confirmStep3: Pastes the stance message and waits for "ready".
launch.confirmStep4: Types /goal with the goal text and checks it is active. Nothing else is sent.
launch.confirmManual: Writes the packet folder for {{id}} in the research home. Nothing is started; you paste the two messages yourself.
launch.willSupersede: Supersedes {{id}}: it is stopped as part of this launch.
launch.limitsUnknown: The packet limits could not be read, so a launch cannot be prepared here.

launchStatus.relaunchDescription: Builds a new commission from the same choices that supersedes {{id}} and carries its baseline. You launch the new packet on the next screen.
launchStatus.manualNote: Works whether or not the desk can start sessions. The desk recognises the session afterwards.
launchStatus.manual1: Open a new Codex session in Web Console.
launchStatus.manual2: Paste the stance message and send it.
launchStatus.manual4: Send the goal line, then nothing else.
launchStatus.uncertainTitle: The desk cannot tell whether this packet was started
launchStatus.nothingHere: This commission has already started or ended; there is nothing to launch here.
launchStatus.uncertainManualTitle: This packet cannot be launched as it is
launchStatus.uncertainManual: The desk cannot tell whether this packet was started, so pasting its messages could start a second supervisor. Relaunch it as a new commission instead.
launchStatus.neverStartedNote: The desk found no session or goal for it, but cannot know for sure. Only you can say it never started; the launch records that you said so.
launchStatus.neverStarted: I know it was never started
launchStatus.assertRecorded: You say this packet was never started; that is recorded in its LAUNCH.json.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Review sessions over chosen topics: what was accomplished, and your verdict on each.
reviews.empty: A review appears here when the research-review skill writes reviews/<id>/REVIEW.md.
reviews.verdictsNote: Recorded verbatim in VERDICTS.md. Missions change only when you realign them.
reviews.topicsUnknown: Which topics this review covers is not known: {{reason}} Choose a topic below to record a verdict.
reviews.confirmDescription: Appended to the review's VERDICTS.md exactly as written.
reviews.otherTopicNote: For a topic this review covers without a section of its own.

desk.title: Desk
desk.description: What the desk can reach, how it starts sessions and delivers decisions, and its two self-tests.
desk.optionalNote: Research runs without any of these. When one is down, only what it provides shows as unknown.
desk.testsNote: Each touches real services and never runs on its own; run one only when you want to prove that launching, or delivery to your phone, works.
desk.launchTestDescription: Creates one throwaway Codex session labelled as a research-desk launch test, sends a fixed harmless stance and goal, then pauses, resumes and stops it. Nothing is written in the research home.
desk.courierTestHint: Sends you one test decision and waits up to a minute for your phone to receive it.
desk.courierTestTitle: Send a test decision to your phone?
desk.courierTestDescription: Sends one decision through Notification Hub with the options Seen and Not seen, and waits up to a minute for a device to receive it. No answer is needed. The desk cannot withdraw it; it expires unanswered after 15 minutes.
desk.courierTestText: Research desk delivery test <time> — no answer needed; it expires unanswered in 15 minutes.
desk.courierDelivered: Delivered to your phone after {{seconds}} s.
desk.courierNotDelivered: No device received it within {{seconds}} s.
desk.courierExpires: The test decision stays open until it expires

errors.unreachable: The research desk did not answer. Research keeps running; this page tries again every 30 seconds.
errors.unauthorized: This session is not authorized for the desk. Sign in again.
errors.refusedTitle: The desk could not do this
errors.stale: Showing what was read at {{time}}. The latest read failed: {{reason}}

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: This screen failed to render. Try again, or reload if it persists. Research is not affected.

unreadable.title: {{count}} files cannot be read
unreadable.note: What they hold is unknown, not empty. Everything else on this screen is read as usual.
unreadable.headingsNote: They do not follow the file's format, so what they hold is not shown here. Read them in the file at these lines.

entry.countNoLimit: {{used}} characters (the entry limit could not be read; the desk will refuse the write)
entry.tooLong: Too long for one entry. Put the material in a file under {{home}} and write its path here instead.
entry.refused: Too long for one entry. Put the material in a file under the research home and write its path instead.
entry.preparing: Asking the desk for the exact text…

access.credential: The desk starts sessions in Web Console with its own service credential.
access.availability: The desk has no credential of its own: it starts sessions the way any program on this computer can, because Web Console lets anyone who reaches it act.
access.unknown: How the desk reaches Web Console is not known: {{said}}
access.unavailable: The desk cannot read its Web Console credential, so it does not start or steer sessions there.
